title: 742. Parse Lisp Expression

examples.explanation: x binds to 2, then 2 times 5 is 10.

hints: Parse with an index pointer over the string plus a stack of scopes; each let pushes bindings that are discarded at ')'.
To evaluate a list, read its head token: add and mult take exactly two sub-expressions, let takes pairs plus a trailing body.
A bare token is either an integer literal or a variable resolved from the innermost scope outward.
